name: claudespeak
description: Reads a 1-3 sentence summary of each finished Claude Code reply aloud with Fish Audio, one voice at a time across sessions

voiceId.title: Fish voice id
voiceId.description: Fish Audio reference_id of the voice that speaks replies (default: Sawyer)

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: Small fast model that turns a long reply into 1-3 spoken sentences

minSeconds.title: Speak only after long turns
minSeconds.description: Read a reply aloud only when the turn ran at least this many seconds. 0 reads every reply.

dailyCharLimit.title: Daily spoken-character limit
dailyCharLimit.description: Stop speaking for the day after this many characters, to cap Fish Audio credits. 0 means no limit.

redact.title: Hide private details
redact.description: Replace email addresses, phone numbers and money amounts before anything is sent to Fish Audio or spoken.
